ratio_privacy-policy_default.title: Privacy Policy
ratio_privacy-policy_default.subtitle: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you shop with us.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly to us — such as your name, email address, shipping address, phone number, and payment details — when you place an order, create an account, or contact us.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to:
bullets: Communicate with you about your orders and account
Improve our products, services, and website experience
Send you marketing communications where you have opted in

sections.heading: Sharing Your Information
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with trusted service providers who help us operate our store — such as payment processors, shipping partners, and analytics providers — and only to the extent necessary to provide their services.

sections.heading: Cookies & Tracking
sections.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences, keep items in your cart, and understand how our site is used. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information, or to object to certain processing. To exercise these rights, please contact us.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please reach out to us through our Contact page.
